sources.title: OpenGVLab/InternVL3_5-30B-A3B-HF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Quick Start We provide an example code to run InternVL3.5-8B-HF using transformers. Please note that our models with up to 30B parameters can be deployed on a single A100 GPU, while the 38B model requires two A100 GPUs and the 235B model requires eight A100 GPUs. In most cases, both LMDeploy and vLLM can be used for model deployment.

sources.title: InternVL3.5
sources.snippet: For the Flash version of InternVL3.5, we additionally introduce a lightweight training stage, termed Visual Consistency Learning (ViCO), which reduces the token cost required to represent an image patch. Here, we also open-source the model weights after different training stages for potential research usage.
